title: Branch and revision selectors
responsibility: Lets users choose a branch, viewed commit and optional comparison base.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.index
inputs.description: Required repository index supplying branch choices.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.commits
inputs.description: Required available viewed revisions, shown with their abbreviated commits and descriptions.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.bases
inputs.description: Required comparison revisions or null. Null hides the base selector; an empty list leaves it with no revision choices.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.onbranch
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected branch name.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.oncommit
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected viewed commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.onbase
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the selected comparison-base commit.

inputs.name: HarnessSelectors.tip
inputs.type: { note: string; viewed: string; href: string | null; onfollow: () => void } | null
inputs.description: Optional branch-tip notice, defaulting to null. Supplies its note, viewed commit, destination and follow callback; the tip action is disabled without a destination.

outputs.name: HarnessSelectors
outputs.description: Native branch, commit and optional base selectors. In the navbar they form one compact row with middle-shortened names, short hashes and full hover details. Selecting a value invokes its matching callback.
